Changelog Dungeon Coup 1.0.5

notes.title: Dungeon Coup Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hey friends!
 
Here I am, late but with a new update for Dungeon Coup!
This is another bugfix, there is no new content but stuff will work better now.
One important thing that I found, and I was actually wrong: The hanging girl wasn’t spawning all the time as I thought. Lots of people told me they didn’t find her, so I checked and...well she only spawned 2 times out of 10 in my test. So yeah, sorry for that. I have fixed it so it spawns 100% of the time when it should spawn.
 
Today I'm starting with the next Kinky Fight Club update. I'm a bit late with work, because, well mostly the usual stuff, family, medical stuff, and well, this past week I moved to a new place, so all in all I could barely work in the last 10 days, but hey, here it is at last!
The update is already up on both platforms where you can get the game: Steam and Itch.
If you haven’t please leave a review, it helps the game gain a bit more traction!
Have a nice weekend friends!
 
And we will see soon with the news for november!
Cheers!

Changelog Dungeon Coup - 1.0.4

 Rewritten level unlock code to ensure that each level correctly unlocks the next level in Arcade mode and Story mode.
 Fixed an issue that caused sometimes the ending to not properly unlock the Extra stuff.
 Fixed an issue that could possibly cause an error in saving characters.
 Fixed an issue that locked the cursor when returning to the main menu after playing in story.
 Fixed an issue that caused the hanging girl to not properly spawn most of the time in the 5th floor of story mode.
 Fixed an issue that caused the Role settings in story to not be properly read when selected mixed enemies.
 Fixed an issue that caused the Enemy gender settings in story to not be properly read when selecting mixed enemy roles.
 Fixed an issue that caused the invulnerable buff to be lost if you are grappled while you activate the chest.
 Improved the selection box for each type of binding. (Fixing a possible issue on some screens making it not possible to select the "No bindings" option.
 Fixed an error where Crimson would have the dialogue of Lucy during the sex scene.
 Fixed an issue where in the sex scene the enemies may get the settings wrong. (being futa when they shouldn't!)
 Fixed an issue with a particular hair having more textures than others and causing loading problems under some specific situations.
 Starting on this update, Sex scenes in story mode will auto-advance after 30 seconds, in order to prevent a bug that I couldn't reproduce to fix.

notes.title: 1.0.3 Bugfix update!
notes.content:
Hey Masters!

I been working this week to fix more bugs, there are two issues I still cannot pinpoint where or why they happen: The first is when the UI suddenly becomes unresponsive and you cannot click on buttons, I'm having a hard time trying to reproduce this bug, and the other is the collision error that one guy got, Ill fix them as soon as I can find what causes them.
There are more fixes to come in the future, but that’s all I could get done this week.

Note: Steam players, this fix does not include the base Dungeon Coup custom characters in the Characters/local folder, but rather in a different folder, you can copy and paste those files in the Characters/local folder.  Why am I doing this? because if I include those files in the Characters/local folder, it will automatically overwrite your own characters on each update. 

Without more talk here is the changelog, as always im happy to receive feedback and bug reports on discord!

Changelog Dungeon Coup 1.0.3


 Fixed an issue that caused the cursor to not be visible sometimes when returning to the main menu after a lose scene.
 Fixed an issue in the archivist room.
 Corrected the phrase in the Customization menu for story mode, now it reads: "Press Customize to modify your character".
 While in Beginner difficulty, Willpower regeneration is increased by 50%!
 While in Beginner difficulty, Stamina regeneration is increased by 35%!
 Added a system to destroy the Story data leftovers when returning to main menu, this should prevent data leaking from story character to other characters.
 Fixed an issue with the customization and story mode. Now customization should work properly, either in story mode or outside story mode.
 Added a small 1 sec CD to some of the buttons in the Lose scene, to ensure that nothing breaks if spammed.
 Submissives who came now take 30% longer to get up.
 Fixed an issue with the sex position Piledriver handjob displaying the wrong animation when both characters are female and passive.
 Fixed a rare issue that could cause the player o submissives to be stuck on the ceiling.
 Added an emergency measure to return the player back to the start point in case they would fall through the ground.
 Adjusted the position for the cumming animation of Prone Doggystyle 3.
 Fixed an issue that caused the masters in the Lose room to be always male or futa.
 Added a small CD to some of the buttons in the sex scenes, to ensure that nothing breaks in transitions.
 Fixed an issue that could cause the dialogue to get stuck when in the library talking with Master Axel.
 Fixed an issue with the stage selection that would prevent the Room 0 to be unlocked as a default.
 Fixed a typo in the stage selection.
 Fixed an issue in story mode sometimes not unlocking the Gallery run. 
 Fixed an issue that caused unlocked floors to not work properly.
 Improved the functionality for unlocking stuff.
 Increased the time enemies take to stop jerking when the player is caught by 2 seconds. (Giving the player 2 extra seconds to get up and run)
 Increased the invulnerability time after getting up by 2 seconds. (for a total of 5 seconds)
 Fixed an issue that caused the buttons to get unselected in the game over scene.

notes.title: First day bugfix update!
notes.content:
Hey friends!

Sorry for the bugs, I'll keep fixing bugs as soon as people report them!

Right now there two issues that I wanna mention

First: Someone people told me that they got stuck in the “New story” screen, and are unable to do anything there, until they reset the game. They also told that Avast got triggered and got a false positive on the game (which is weird) but creating an exception for it solved the issue. Now, why does this happen? I have no idea, I have avast myself and this never happened to me. If you are unsure about this, feel free to scan the game anywhere you want before proceeding.

Second: There was a bug with the character creation in Story mode when changing genders: It wrongly added cat ears in the Extras slots (regardless of if Neko mode is on or off) this bug has been fixed for new characters, but if this happen to a character that you already started the story there is an easy way to fix this: Go to customization and just change the cloth pieces in Extra 1, 2 and 3, all of them are the neko ears badly assigned, if you fix it there they won’t pop up again. Another possibility is just changing genders again, but that will delete your costume selection.

With that being said, here is the Changelog, and Thanks for buying the game or supporting the project!

Changelog Dungeon Coup - 1.0.1

 Added a back to menu button in New Story, hopefully it won't bug now. I can't find why it bugs out yet.
 Added an emergency "Back to menu" function, by pressing ESCAPE during Story dialogues and new story.
 Fixed an issue that caused the player to count as being near the Restraints in the gallery. Moving away from the restraints will prevent you from using them.
 Separated two settings from story mode and non-story mode: Now in Story mode when starting a new game you can select the [Force all females to be futanari] or [Force all males to be femboys] options. These options are independent from the Arcade mode options, and they won't override each other.
 Fixed an issue that prevented the gender of the character to be displayed correctly.
 Added an extra security step to prevent possible character customization errors when swapping genders and not adjusting costumes.
 Fixed an issue with the animation Side Doggystyle 2 not starting properly in the sex scene.
 Fixed an issue with a text showing that wasn't supposed to show in the Sex scene in Story.
 Fixed an issue that added cat ears when swapping genders.
 Fixed an issue with story mode causing the Character Creator to get stuck.
 Added a failsafe for preventing Story/Arcade discrepancies bugs.
